instruction: Cinematic medium shot of three young girls standing close together in a sunny park. On the left, the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan (R3) smiles warmly at the camera, holding the center girl's arm. In the center, the girl with a pink headband (R6) smiles gently, looking forward. On the right, the girl with bangs in a blue cardigan (R4) smiles happily, wrapping her arm around the center girl's shoulder. Bright golden hour sunlight shines directly from behind them, creating a prominent lens flare and a soft, glowing atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
